title: project immutable external object publication candidate for the RC8 payload bytes

files.role: installer handoff for RC9-011 and RC9-012

criteria: The projection script binds the RC8 descriptor, current payload bytes, public signature receipt, and mirror metadata before any external object publication claim.
The result records publication_denied_as_expected=true when no immutable external HTTPS object URI exists.
The denial evidence includes external-https-object-uri-not-published and declared-current-artifact-drift-unresolved blockers.
The installer handoff keeps quarantine fetch, install, activation, rollback, support upload, and remote dispatch blocked.
The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and moves the next task to RC9-011 artifact drift reconciliation.
